## Summary

Methodology tweet: **always build with a clear hypothesis first** — a key lesson Martin takes from Sersan's blogs, reinforced across his other writing. Before beginning to build any strategy, there's a lot of work done BEFORE (truncated) — i.e., the hypothesis and its economic rationale precede code. The quoted Peter tweet supplies the negative case: hunters of very-short-term seasonal tendencies (right weekday, hour, filter → nice backtest → "an edge") deserve skepticism even when profitable out-of-sample.
